verdict.rationale: Mastra explicitly supports model routing through a standard interface connecting to 40+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.), which is designed precisely to let developers swap LLM providers/models without rewriting agent logic. Missing for 10: no hands-on independent verification of a live provider-swap with zero code changes, and no detail on edge cases (e.g., provider-specific features breaking portability).
